title: Compute Wiener indices of cozero-divisor graphs of finite rings

source.citation: Wiener index of the Cozero-divisor graph of a finite commutative ring, arXiv:2210.01570

translation.notes: Principal ideals in `Z/nZ` are encoded by their gcd with `n`; two vertices are adjacent exactly when these ideals are incomparable. Noether shortest paths reproduce the paper’s tabulated value `2954`.
